title: SD Beasain
text: Sociedad Deportiva Beasain (Beasain Kirol Elkartea in Basque) is a Spanish football team based in Beasain, in the autonomous community of Basque Country. Founded in 1905 it plays in Tercera Federación – Group 4, holding home games at Estadio Loinaz, with a capacity of 6,000 seats.
